title: cenchrus ciliaris var. setigerus
intro: Cenchrus ciliaris var. setigerus, commonly known as desert broomgrass or blue grama, is a variety of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include treating gastrointestinal issues, wounds, and fever, as well as reducing inflammation and pain. The therapeutic actions of Cenchrus ciliaris var. setigerus are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating a range of health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
